summary: A bug fix in one repo (hono) that updates middleware to cancel discarded response bodies when c.res is replaced; the ticket states clear behavior and acceptance criteria, so quick_fix is appropriate.

steps.why: The ticket describes the bug and acceptance criteria clearly but needs a structured story with implementation notes.
steps.instructions: Write a complete implementable story with file plan, cancellation logic, and test cases. Focus on etag() and prettyJSON() middleware as primary examples; note that other middleware (cache, compress, timeout, jsx-renderer, secure-headers) must retain their current behavior. Include concrete implementation guidance on where to cancel bodies, how to handle clone() branches, error handling that prevents 500 responses, and regression test cases for: etag with preset ETag, etag with generated ETag, prettyJSON formatting, prettyJSON passthrough (204, non-JSON), body reuse, failed release, and header merging with set-cookie.

steps.why: Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: Only one spec artifact (the inline story) exists, so there is nothing to cross-check for consistency.
